title: Loomwright — Weave Draft Studio
description: Draft real cloth: set the threading, tie-up and treadling, dye the yarns, and export the woven fabric.
concept: Loomwright is a working weaving-draft editor. You edit the three grids a floor loom actually needs — threading (which shaft each warp end goes on), tie-up (which shafts each treadle lifts) and treadling (the treadle order) — and the interlacement underneath is computed from them, pick by pick, exactly as the loom would weave it. Ten real structures are built in, from plain weave and 2/2 twill to 8-shaft satin, diamond twill, houndstooth and log cabin, and painting the warp and weft colour bars produces genuine colour-and-weave effects. The cloth panel renders the result as shaded yarn you can export as a PNG, and every draft can be saved, shared as a URL or exported as JSON.
features: Three interactive draft grids — threading, tie-up and treadling — with drag-to-paint editing
10 built-in structures (plain, twill 2/2 and 3/1, point, diamond, rosepath, 8-shaft satin, basket, houndstooth, log cabin) plus a seeded 'surprise' generator
Warp and weft yarn painting with 6 palettes, A/B yarn slots and 1/1–8/8 colour-order generators
Shaded cloth preview with adjustable yarn size and relief, tiled to a full fabric repeat
Live cloth analysis: longest warp and weft floats, warp-on-face percentage, structural repeat and a weavability warning
Export the cloth as PNG, the draft as JSON, import JSON back, and share the whole draft in a URL hash
Named draft library plus autosave in localStorage; keyboard shortcuts for presets, view, surprise and export

interaction.mouse: Drag inside the threading and treadling grids to redraw them; drag the top and right colour bars to dye warp ends and picks.
interaction.click: Click tie-up cells to toggle which shafts a treadle lifts; click a swatch to load the A or B yarn slot; buttons export PNG/JSON, share a link or save the draft.
interaction.touch: Every grid and colour bar is drag-paintable with a finger; Draft/Cloth tabs switch panes on small screens.
interaction.keyboard: 1–0 load the ten structures, r weaves a surprise draft, v flips draft/cloth, e exports the cloth PNG, s focuses the save field.
